documents.name: observatory.txt
documents.text: The Meridian Observatory is located in Jaipur. The observatory opens at 9 AM from Tuesday to Sunday. Adult admission costs 200 rupees. Children under twelve enter free. Telescope sessions begin at 4 PM.

documents.name: leave-policy.txt
documents.text: Employees receive twenty days of annual leave. Leave requests must be submitted seven days in advance. Sick leave requires notifying the team manager before 10 AM. Unused annual leave can carry over for three months.

documents.name: product-guide.txt
documents.text: The Aurora camera has a 24 megapixel sensor. Battery life is approximately eight hours. The camera supports waterproof operation down to ten metres. Firmware updates are downloaded through the companion application.

documents.name: shipping.txt
documents.text: Standard shipping takes five business days. Express shipping takes two business days. Returns are accepted within thirty days of delivery. Customers receive a full refund when returned items are unused.
